newsitem.title: USA: NAPM SAYS JULY OVERALL INDEX AT 2-1/2-YEAR HIGH.
newsitem.headline: NAPM SAYS JULY OVERALL INDEX AT 2-1/2-YEAR HIGH.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) said Friday that its overall index of July manufacturing activity had risen to its highest level in 2-1/2 years.
Meanwhile, the group's production indicator printed at its stongest level in more than 9-1/2-years, and the new orders component registered a three-year high.

Earlier Friday, the NAPM reported its index of manufacturing activity at 58.6 percent in July, up from 55.7 in June and the highest since November 1994 when it registered 59.1. Production was reported at 64.4 percent, up from 56.0 in June and the strongest since December of 1987. At that time, the production index stood at 65.1.
The new orders component came in at 64.6 percent against 62.0 in June, a three-year high.
An overall NAPM index reading above 50.0 percent suggests an expanding U.S. economy, while an index below that mark indicates a contracting economy.
